label: Entailment
evidence: will not disclose it to any third party for any reason or purpose whatsoever without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party ... "third party" means any party other than Client and AfriGIS and their holding and subsidiary companies or agents ... is disclosed to a third party pursuant to the prior written authorisation of the Disclosing Party
reason: Although clause 3.4 bars disclosure to professional advisors, the Receiving Party may still share Confidential Information with its agents and affiliates (excluded from 'third party') and with third parties given prior written consent, so sharing with some third parties is permitted.
